info.title: GTFS Scorecard read API
info.summary: The static files the scorecard publishes, described as a read API.
info.description:
The scorecard publishes static files and nothing else: no query server, no
authentication, and no write path. Every path below is a file on the host
that serves this document. `docs/api.md` is the prose contract; this file
describes the same paths in a form tools can read, and adds none.

Where a document carries a `schema_version`, tolerate added fields and treat
a change in the major version as a breaking change worth pinning against.
`x-artifact-schema-version-major` names the major version of the per-agency
artifact this description was written against.

Where a path has a JSON Schema under `/schemas/`, its response references it.
Where none exists, the response says only that it is a JSON object, and
`docs/api.md` stays the contract for its fields.

The data is offered under CC BY 4.0. Reuse it, including commercially, with
the attribution in `x-attribution`. A grade is a derived data-quality
signal, not a compliance determination.

agency_id.name: agency_id
agency_id.description: A published feed record's id, as listed in `/data/artifacts/index.json`. `changes`, `rollups` and `run` are reserved and are never agency ids.

rollup_id.name: rollup_id
rollup_id.description: A rollup id, as listed in `/data/artifacts/rollups/index.json`.

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: Every file is served with `*`, so it can be read from a browser or an edge function.

JsonObject.description: A JSON object. `docs/api.md` is the contract for its fields.

Artifact.description: One scorecard. The pipeline validates every artifact against this schema before writing it.

Csv.description: Comma-separated values with a header row.

Parquet.description: An Apache Parquet file, served as a generic binary type.

AtomFeed.description: An Atom 1.0 feed, served as generic XML.

NoCurrentFile.description: No current file. The id is unknown, or it is a retired alias whose unversioned current files were removed; its dated snapshots remain.

Artifact.description: One agency's complete scored result for one snapshot (latest.json and <date>.json). The core contract is publish.build_artifact; the optional blocks are attached by the collect run. The top level is closed: adding a key requires updating this schema, which is the enforcement point.

scoring_profile.description: Identity and provenance of the scoring contract that produced the unchanged score fields. This is not a jurisdiction overlay or compliance determination.

validator_version.description: MobilityData gtfs-validator release that produced the correctness notices; null when correctness was not measured.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; omitted for US agencies so their artifacts stay byte-identical. Registry configuration determines which well-formed country codes this deployment activates.

operating_note.description: Curator-verified operating status, mainly for long-expired feeds; omitted when empty.

ntd_note.description: Curator-recorded NTD reporting arrangement (shared feed, waiver); omitted when empty.

state.description: Deprecated US-only compatibility name; omitted when unlocated.

subdivision_code.description: Primary catalog subdivision as an ISO 3166-2 code; omitted when unknown.

subdivision_name.description: Practitioner-facing name of the primary catalog subdivision; omitted when unknown.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp derived from the snapshot date, so re-running a day is byte-identical.

source_provenance.description: Registry-backed relationship of the configured feed URL to its publisher. This is independent from fetch.source, which records how this run obtained the bytes. A recognized TransitFeeds URL is archive; otherwise is_official true/false maps to official/third_party and absence stays unverified.

auth.description: Present only when the feed URL required a credential (issue #371). The credential was supplied by reference from the pipeline's environment; the artifact never carries the credential or the name of the variable holding it.

auth_kind.description: How the credential was presented: as a request header, a URL query parameter, or HTTP basic authentication.

confidence.description: Measurement-confidence read (EXP-01): how much of this grade the pipeline could measure this run and from what source. A legibility layer on the one grade, never a second grade; absent on artifacts published before schema 1.5.

recommendations.description: Beyond-the-grade opportunities (Fares v2, Flex, accessibility); zero-deduction.

conformance.description: Conformance-mark credential over the scores (conformance.assess). The independent version changes when derived machine-readable guidance must be refreshed.

geo.description: Median stop point + bbox for the national map; absent when the feed has no located stops.

route_map.description: Compact route/stop geometry summary; the drawable GeoJSON lives in geometry.geojson.

mode_profile.description: Descriptive, ungraded service modes derived from routes.txt and weighted by trips.txt.

ferry_profile.description: Descriptive, ungraded capability measurements for the ferry routes and trips in a feed. Fare and realtime facts are explicitly whole-feed scope.

routability.description: Zero-deduction routing usability checks (single-stop trips, orphan stops).

export_diff.description: What changed in the feed content since the previous export (EXP-18); present only on the run that first scored a changed export with structural differences.

ntd_id_alignment.description: RY2026 agency_id presence plus optional equality comparison with the NTD ID; US agencies only (ADR 0016/0026).

ntd_readiness.description: NTD certification readiness (published / valid / current / agency_id present); US agencies only.

shapes_readiness.description: shapes.txt trip coverage for FTA's July 2025 NTD shapes requirement (Full Reporters RY2025; Reduced, Rural, and Tribal Reporters RY2026); present only where the check ran.

autofix.description: Corrected-feed offer: what the safe deterministic fixes changed, and where the patched zip lives.

recompute.description: Freshness-sweep provenance: when and why the artifact was reswept without a refetch.

ArtifactConsequence.description: Per-finding consequence block (consequence.py). Reach is computed from this artifact. Ridership and served-area need are properties of the feed and are null with a reason wherever the writer did not join them; not_joined_here means the step that wrote this record does not read that input, not that the data does not exist.

ArtifactConsequenceNeed.description: A within-country need tier with the scale that produced it, or null with the reason it is not known. Tiers from different scales are not comparable.

ArtifactConsequenceReach.description: A share with an empty reason, or a null share with the reason it is not known. Never both. A finding with basis none has no share. Identifiers and labels that do not apply are null, never empty strings.

ArtifactConsequenceRidership.description: Annual rider-trips with an empty reason, or null with the reason they are not known. An absence is never published as zero.

rank.description: 1-based position in top_fixes; present only there.

consequence.description: What this finding costs: network reach, annual rider-trips, and served-area need, each a value or null with a reason. Added in schema 1.19; absent on older snapshots.

ByLocation.x-title: GTFS Scorecard country and subdivision rollups
ByLocation.description: Additive API v1 location rollups. Count fields cover all published feed records in a location; score aggregates use the guarded comparison cohort and expose its denominator. Null codes collect rows whose curated location is unknown.

Catalog.description: Flat list of every published feed scorecard. Additive within a major schema_version: tolerate unknown fields.

rubric_version.description: The sole rubric version present in agencies, or mixed when rows span versions; unknown when no row records one.

rubric_versions.description: Sorted rubric-version values present in row provenance; unknown represents a row without a version.

comparison_eligible.description: Whether this row belongs to the current producer-, category-, and identity-safe comparison cohort.

national_percentile.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Current payloads publish null; integers remain valid only so historical 1.x documents still conform.

peer_percentile.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Current payloads publish null; integers remain valid only so historical 1.x documents still conform.

service_horizon_status.description: Whether the effective service end date extends beyond the scorecard's conservative review threshold. Unusually distant is a display and trust advisory outside category findings, not a GTFS error or score deduction.

ntd_ready.description: Readiness for the FTA NTD GTFS requirement, rolled up from the published/valid/current/agency_id pillars. A data-quality heads-up, never an official determination: ready = all four pillars hold; at_risk = a recoverable or unchecked gap; not_ready = unreachable, lapsed, or missing agency_id. NTD is a US-federal concept, so this is null for non-US agencies (ADR 0026).

google_gate.description: Whether the feed clears the Google/Apple Maps four-week service-coverage bar: pass = four or more weeks ahead; at_risk = under four weeks; fail = expired.

stops.description: Boardable stop count read from the feed's stops.txt.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Registry configuration determines which well-formed country codes this deployment activates.

Directory.description: Slim per-scorecard directory plus guarded covered-corpus and location summaries. Additive within a major schema_version: tolerate unknown fields.

countries.description: Portable country rollups with nested ISO 3166-2 subdivisions. The legacy states array is unchanged.

comparison_eligible.description: Whether this row belongs to the comparison cohort documented in summary.comparison.

national_percentile.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Current payloads publish null; integers remain valid only so historical 1.x documents still conform.

peer_percentile.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Current payloads publish null; integers remain valid only so historical 1.x documents still conform.

ntd_ready.description: NTD GTFS certification readiness heads-up; null for non-US agencies (see catalog schema).

google_gate.description: Google/Apple Maps four-week coverage bar (see catalog schema).

feed_url.description: The static GTFS URL that was scored.

feed_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact feed bytes scored.

retrieved_at.description: When the feed was fetched and scored (ISO 8601).

rubric_version.description: Rubric version that produced this grade.

scoring_profile_id.description: Stable scoring-profile identifier that produced this grade.

scoring_profile_rubric_version.description: Rubric version declared by the scoring profile.

scorecard_url.description: Canonical scorecard page for this agency.

top_fix.description: The highest-leverage plain-language fix, when any.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Registry configuration determines which well-formed country codes this deployment activates.

modes_measured.description: Whether the route-mode contract was measured for this feed.

GlobalCoverage.x-title: GTFS Scorecard global coverage readiness gate
GlobalCoverage.description: Auditable readiness criteria for the bounded European GTFS Schedule beta. Counts are reviewed feed records, not agencies, operators, routes, or all European transit.

retrieved_at.description: Raw published timestamp. Malformed values remain visible and are identified by freshness_status.

Rollup.description: One program's cohort view: members needing attention first, common fixes counted only across the guarded comparison cohort, and expiry / shapes-readiness summaries over all members. Additive within a major schema_version: newer fields stay optional so older published documents still conform. Top level is closed (additionalProperties: false) so a new block cannot reach production without a schema update, the same enforcement point as artifact.schema.json.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 identity carried by country rollups (rollups.py _rollup_identity, shipped with the country program pages) so renderers can state the cohort's scope without keying off id naming conventions. Absent on state and named-cohort rollups.

country_name.description: Display name for country_code, resolved by the pipeline's location tables.

top_fix_code.description: Finding code for the member's highest-priority fix, used to preserve evidence context when opening its scorecard.

state_percentile.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Current payloads publish null; historical 1.x state rollups may contain an integer.

reconciliation.description: How this program's feed records line up with an external agency directory published by a transport authority. Present only for programs with a mapped directory. Never a grade input.

realtime.description: Realtime reliability across this program's members, from the scheduled realtime monitor's record. Members the monitor has not observed are counted as unmonitored, never as a zero. Not a grade input.

RollupIndex.description: The list of published program rollups with one summary row each, written beside the per-rollup documents as rollups/index.json.
